1.text: Ba shebuja, mugirire imbata zanyu ibitunganye n'ibikwiriye, kuko muzi yuko namwe mufite Shobuja uri mu ijuru.

3.text: Kandi natwe mudusabire kugira ngo Imana idukingurire urugi rwo kuvuga ijambo ryayo, tuvuge ubwiru bwa Kristo, ubwo nabohewe

4.text: kugira ngo mbwerekane nk'uko nkwiriye kuvuga.

5.text: Mugendere mu bwenge ku byo mugirira abo hanze, mucunguze uburyo umwete.

6.text: Ijambo ryanyu rifatanye iteka n'ubuntu bw'Imana risīze umunyu, kugira ngo mumenye uko mukwiriye gusubiza umuntu wese.

7.text: Tukiko, mwene Data ukundwa w'umubwiriza w'iby'Imana ukiranuka, ni umugaragu mugenzi wanjye ukorera mu Mwami wacu, azababwira ibyanjye byose.

8.text: Ni we mbatumyeho ku bw'ibyo ngo mumenye ibyacu kandi ahumurize imitima yanyu,

9.text: mutumanye na Onesimo mwene Data wo kwizerwa kandi ukundwa, mwene wanyu, bazabamenyesha iby'ino byose.

10.text: Arisitariko uwo tubohanywe arabatashya, na Mariko mwene se wabo wa Barinaba arabatashya na we. (Uwo ni we mwategetswe, naramuka aje iwanyu muzamwakire.)

11.text: Na Yesu witwa Yusito arabatashya, abo ni bo bonyine bo mu bakebwe bakorana nanjye ku bw'ubwami bw'Imana kandi bamaze umubabaro.

12.text: Epafura mwene wanyu arabatashya, na we ni imbata ya Kristo Yesu ibarwanira iteka ikabasabira, kugira ngo muhagarare mushikamye kandi mutunganye rwose, mumenya neza mudashidikanya ibyo Imana ishaka byose.

13.text: Ndi umugabo wo kumuhamya yuko abagirira umwete mwinshi, mwebwe n'ab'i Lawodikiya n'ab'i Hiyerapoli.

14.text: Luka umuvūzi ukundwa, na Dema barabatashya.

15.text: Muntahirize bene Data b'i Lawodikiya, na Numfa n'Itorero ryo mu nzu ye.

16.text: Uru rwandiko nimumara kurusomerwa ruzasomerwe n'Itorero ry'i Lawodikiya, namwe muzasome uruzava i Lawodikiya.

17.text: Kandi muzabwire Arukipo muti “Ujye urinda umurimo wo kugabura iby'Imana wahawe ku bw'Umwami wacu, uwusohoze.”

18.text: Uku ni ko gutashya kwanjye Pawulo, kwanditswe n'ukwanjye kuboko. Mwibuke ingoyi zanjye.Ubuntu bw'Imana bubane namwe.
